messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: "Hosted-Inference: high p95 latency" fired for service=hosted-inference env=prod
incident-bot: Trigger: p95 > 300ms for 2m. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incident/PD12345 :rotating_light:
Alex B.: acked via PD, I'm on it. pulling traces.
Maria C.: I'm grabbing autoscaler logs, could be node pressure after the batch job.
Siva K.: seeing a spike in seq len for a subset of requests, KV cache hit rate dropped to 12% vs 78% normal.
Jordan H.: any customer reports yet?
Alex B.: customer-facing side — 2 support tickets, embeddings latency spikes for a reseller tenant. Not yet widespread.
Siva K.: running quick query:
```
kubectl -n prod logs deploy/inference-router --since=5m | grep "latency_p95"
# shows repeated 350-420ms across replicas r5-7
```
Maria C.: autoscaler events: scale up happened but nodes reporting OOMKilled on model-hosts-3, may be quantization profile mismatch.
Lee T.: PD didn't get an ack within 3m from primary -> PagerDuty escalated to secondary (oncall: Jordan H.)
pagerduty-bot: Escalation: Assigned to Jordan H.; if no ack in 5m escalates to manager oncall.
Jordan H.: acking now. jumping in.
Alex B.: plan: 1) roll traffic to smaller model-variant served on spare pool 2) restart model-hosts-3 after removing bad quant config 3) rewarm caches
Siva K.: I can patch cache eviction to prioritize KV prefixes for the reseller tenant, pushing a hotfix now.
Maria C.: taking the restart, will cordon and drain node then bring it back with corrected config.
incident-bot: Note: PD escalation policy also sent SMS to manager (Maya R.) at 1765438990 — potential manager escalation if next ack missed.
Alex B.: pushing config: /etc/redwood/model/quant.toml -> rolling update
```
kubectl rollout restart deployment/model-hosts
```
Alex B.: switching 20% traffic to smaller-llm variant (experimental) via routing rule
```
POST /admin/routing
{"service":"hosted-inference","route":"weight","variant":"small-llm","weight":20}
```
Jordan H.: monitoring customer ticket thread, letting support know we have a mitigation. tagging @support-leads
Lee T.: tracking PD escalation timeline. if manager paging hits, will start bridge.
Siva K.: hotfix applied, cache hit for reseller up to 60% — p95 dropped to ~190ms on that tenant.
Maria C.: node restarted, model-hosts-3 back with corrected quant profile. memory stable.
Alex B.: confirm global p95 now 210ms, trending down.
Jordan H.: will keep monitoring for 30m. no manager escalation needed. support notified.
incident-bot: incident summary (auto): 1765438901 — High p95 latency due to KV cache evictions and bad quant profile on one node; mitigated by routing to smaller model, cache hotfix, and node restart. Affected: reseller tenant (embeddings). PD: escalated to secondary during initial ack gap but resolved before manager escalation. Handed off to post-incident review. :white_check_mark:
Lee T.: filing postmortem checklist ticket: https://trello.example/card/RC-567
Alex B.: thanks all — will write up root cause and mitigation notes.
